description: This file defines a handler class for deleting accounting rules in the Fineract system. It implements the command processing for deleting an accounting rule, using the AccountingRuleWritePlatformService.

classes.name: DeleteAccountingRuleCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles delete commands for accounting rules, implementing processCommand to invoke the delete operation on the write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by calling the delete method on the write platform service with the entity ID.
